reviews.text: Today was our second time at the beauty salon and I can only recommend Lejla. We are very satisfied with her work, she is patient, kind and very helpful. It is clear that she loves what she does. Thank you to her!!

Two weeks ago I made an appointment at the beautician for my 15-year-old miniature schnauzer. The beautician canceled it 2 days earlier, citing that our dog had received a rabies vaccination before last year. Next week it will be 34 degrees, which will affect even a healthy dog, but especially our dog at this age. The lady is very far from an animal-loving "professional". So far, she has been to a beautician in Budapest, and no one has ever asked such a question. Our dog has never acted aggressively or bit anyone in her life, be it a veterinarian or a beautician, even though she has been to both places quite often. This is an unacceptable attitude!
You don't need to go to a dog beautician if you are so afraid of dogs.
Maximum knowledge! Lejla is a professional both professionally and personally! Best choice. Thank you for your work! 🐾🐩 …
